name: Glowwood Ruin Court — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Aged pointed-arch ruin court with broken tower/arch tops, roots and moss climbing stone, pale lilac/blue crystal clusters, star niches and a purple suspended star beneath the main arch. Open voids remain between walls; source is not a sealed chapel. Hidden layout inference: A woodland path crosses a small stone circle into the open court, passes a central wishing/crystal focus, then exits through a broken side arch into a grove. Leave roof absent and preserve framed sky/tree views. Keep vegetation at boundaries so broken edges and routes remain legible. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B17-DETAIL-001 — Glowwood Ruin Court — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need broken-wall/arch foot/return variants and root-to-stone attachment views, not another intact Gothic church. Reuse existing crystal/wish-star and moss/fern families after identity check. Suspension of star is unresolved or explicitly magical; owl/moths and possible firefly effects proposed. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
